tools.name: Wikipedia
tools.purpose: Retrieve factual summaries and historical data from Wikipedia.

tools.name: DuckDuckGo Search
tools.purpose: Search the live web for real-time information and statistics.

tools.name: Custom Calculator
tools.purpose: Safely evaluate mathematical expressions extracted from web data.

execution_flow: 2. Gemini evaluates if tools are needed or if it can answer directly.
3. If tools are needed, Gemini returns tool calls.
4. Agent executes Wikipedia, DuckDuckGo, or Calculator safely (catching errors).
5. Agent feeds the observation back to Gemini.
6. Loop repeats until Gemini synthesizes a final text answer.
